text:
tanya: heads-up — ran into a weird interaction between jsonMode function_call helpers and our auth-retry wrapper in the JS SDK. After a 401 refresh, retry payload ends up double-encoded and downstream validator accepts it as string. Works fine in Python.

laura: curious, does the 401 path trigger a different serialization codepath? we've had parity diffs there before.

kevin: yes. repro summary: initial call returns 401 -> SDK refreshes token -> retry sends helper result but the retry serializer treats helper return as already-serialized string and stringifies again. final body looks like `"{\"title\":\"x\"}"` to the model. Python's retry replays original request object and keeps types.

tanya: minimal repro (JS):
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-instruct-1.1',
  jsonMode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'create_note', arguments_schema: noteSchema },
  input: prompt
});
// simulated 401 on first request via auth-stub
// after refresh retry -> helper result serialized twice
```

sasha: which SDK versions? we shipped an auth wrapper refactor in 2.4.x that changed how retry serializes.

tanya: js@2.4.6, py@1.11.0, samplekit v0.27. trace: helper.parse() -> validate() -> return object -> retry.serialize() (stringifies) -> auth refresh -> retry with that string -> model sees quoted string.

kevin: risky because some helper schemas allow string fallback (weird sample scaffolds) and that masks the bug. If samplekit schema permits `type: [\"string\",\"object\"]`, the double-encoded string passes validation and we never surface the parse error.

laura: oy. we should tighten samplekit templates to avoid permissive union types for function_call helpers. Also add an SDK fix: ensure retry serializes only the original request envelope and not the helper return value.

kevin: quick mitigation: in JS SDK set a flag `parseBeforeRetry: true` in helper runner so parsing/validation happen before auth-refresh logic touches the helper output. I'll open a patch. Also add a lint that warns when scaffolded schemas include string/object unions for fncall.

sasha: long-term: change auth-retry to never reserialize helper outputs — just replay the original request body bytes. That avoids mutation differences between first call and retries. Need tests covering streaming + auth refresh.

auth-bot: Created issue DEVEX-1210: "js sdk auth-retry double-encode with jsonMode function_call" assigned to kevin. https://tracker.internal/DEVEX-1210

tanya: also adding integration test in samplekit that flips response to 401 on first attempt and asserts final validated helper args are objects (typeof === 'object'), not strings.

laura: i'll update sample templates to set object-only schemas for helpers and add a scaffold warning when coerceTypes is true and jsonMode is enabled.

kevin: PR opened with parseBeforeRetry and unit tests; adding replay-original-request patch next. pinging here when CI green.

tanya: thanks — this one explains a couple of subtle onboarding bugs where customers saw weird types after auth hiccups. re-running sample-app infra after merge.
